title: PhD Research Fellowships in Economics
institution: University of Oslo, Department of Economics
about: The University of Oslo's Department of Economics is recruiting for five full-time PhD Research Fellow positions in economics. Applications are submitted through Jobbnorge by 15 January 2027; candidates finishing their master's in spring 2027 before 1 August may apply.
requirements: Master's degree or equivalent; candidates completing it in spring 2027 before 1 August 2027 may apply
Applicants from outside the EEA, EU, UK or Switzerland need GRE scores (152 Quantitative, 153 Verbal)
